L267: ## Frequently asked questions
L268: 
L269: The following sections provide answers to frequently asked questions.
L270: 
L271: ### What am I billed for?
L272: 
L273: Gemini API pricing is based on the following:
L274: 
L275:   * Input token count
L276:   * Output token count
L277:   * Cached token count
L278:   * Cached token storage duration
L279: 
L280: For pricing information, see the cite52†Pricing page .
L281: 
L282: ### Where can I view my quota?
L283: 
L284: You can view your quota and system limits in cite23†AI Studio†aistudio.google.com .
L285: ### How do I move to a higher rate limit tier, or request more quota?
L286: 
L287: You will automatically be granted more quota when your account reaches the next cite53†tier requirements .
L288: 
L289: ### Can I use the Gemini API for free in EEA (including EU), the UK, and CH?
L290: 
L291: Yes, we make the free tier and paid tier available in cite54†many regions .
L292: ### If I set up billing with the Gemini API, will I be charged for my Google AI Studio usage?
L293: 
L294: AI Studio usage remains free of charge unless users link a paid API key for access to paid features. Once you link a paid API key as part of a paid project in AI Studio, you will be charged for AI Studio usage for that key. You can switch between Paid Tier projects and Free Tier projects as needed by using the respective API keys linked to each type.
L295: ### If I'm on the Free Tier, how do I upgrade to higher tiers?
L296: 
L297: To access higher tiers, you must set up billing on your project. Click cite9†Set up billing in Google AI Studio. This will walk you through selecting or creating a Cloud Billing account. If you are required to be on the prepaid billing model, the Set up billing process will guide you through the process to create your Prepay account that is linked to your Cloud Billing account.
L298: ### Can I use 1M tokens in the free tier?
L299: 
L300: The free tier for Gemini API differs based on the model selected. For now, you can try the 1M token context window in the following ways:
L301: 
L302:   * In Google AI Studio
L303:   * With free-of-charge plans for select models
L304:   * With postpaid plans
L305: 
L306: ### Can I revert back to Free Tier after I've upgraded to higher (paid) tiers?
L307: 
L308: To downgrade to the Free Tier, you can cite50†disable billing†docs.cloud.google.com on each of your projects that you want to downgrade.
L309: ### How can I calculate the number of tokens I'm using?
L310: 
L311: Use the cite55†`GenerativeModel.count_tokens` method to count the number of tokens. Refer to the cite56†Tokens guide to learn more about tokens.
L312: ### If I sign up for my first Cloud Billing account through AI Studio, will I still get a Google Cloud Free Trial?
L313: When you sign up for your first ever Cloud Billing account, your cite57†Google Cloud Free Trial†docs.cloud.google.com starts and you are granted a $300 cite47†Welcome credit†docs.cloud.google.com . However, those credits can't be used to pay for AI Studio usage. You can use the Welcome credit to pay for other eligible services within Google Cloud (note that once those credits are consumed or expire (within 90 days), any additional usage costs are automatically billed to your established form of payment).
L314: ### Can I use my Google Cloud Welcome credit with the Gemini API?
L315: 
L316: No, the Google Cloud cite47†Welcome credit†docs.cloud.google.com or free trial credit can't be used towards the Gemini API or AI Studio.
L317: 
L318: If you were granted a Google Cloud welcome credit before they became ineligible, you are allowed to spend your remaining credits on the Gemini API and AI Studio up until the credits expire (after 90 days).
L319: ### Does the Google Cloud Free Trial apply to Gemini API usage?
L320: 
L321: No, starting March 2026, Gemini API usage costs are specifically excluded from the cite57†$300 Google Cloud Free Trial†docs.cloud.google.com program.
L322: ### How do Google Cloud credits work with Prepay?
L323: 
L324: Prepay users must first cite25†purchase Prepaid credits before any eligible Google Cloud credits can be applied to Gemini API usage. Once you have an active Prepay credit balance, Google Cloud credits that are eligible for the Gemini API are consumed before your Prepay credit balance. When your Prepay credit balance on the billing account hits $0, Google Cloud credits will no longer be consumed.
L325: Not all Google Cloud credits, such as the cite58†Google Cloud Welcome credit , can be used towards Gemini API and AI Studio.
L326: ### How is billing handled?
L327: 
L328: Billing for the Gemini API is handled by the cite46†Cloud billing†cloud.google.com system. Learn about the in-product Cloud Billing setup in the cite59†Cloud Billing documentation†docs.cloud.google.com .
L329: 
L330: ### Am I charged for failed requests?
L331: 
L332: If your request fails with a 400 or 500 error, you won't be charged for the tokens used. However, the request will still count against your quota.
L336: ### How is my Google AI Studio data handled if I have a paid API account?
L337: 
L338: Refer to the cite60†Terms of service for details on how data is handled when Cloud billing is enabled (see "How Google Uses Your Data" under "Paid Services"). Note that your Google AI Studio prompts are treated under the same "Paid Services" terms so long as at least 1 API project has billing enabled, which you can validate on the cite18†Gemini API key page†aistudio.google.com if you see any projects marked as "Paid" under "Plan".
L342: ### How do I purchase Prepay credits, and is there a minimum amount or maximum?
L343: 
L344: You can cite25†purchase credits on the AI Studio Billing page. During the purchase process, the UI will provide the minimum pre-purchase amount that is required for your region and tier level, as well as a maximum amount that can be in your account at one time.
L345: ### Can I configure my Prepay account to automatically purchase more credits as needed?
L346: 
L347: Yes, we recommend that you configure cite26†auto-reload in the AI Studio Billing settings. You specify a "trigger" credit balance (e.g., "when my balance falls below $30") and a "reload value" (e.g., "add $100").
L348: ### Can I limit the amount of automatic reload charges?
L349: 
L350: Yes, Prepay users can set a cite61†Monthly Auto-Charge Limit within the Auto-Reload widget. When the total amount of automatic reloads in a billing cycle reaches this limit, the system disables auto-reload until the next month. Manual credit purchases do not count toward this limit.
L351: 
L352: ### Can I get a refund for my unused credits?
L353: 
L354: All Prepaid API credits expire after 1 year and cannot be refunded. Read the cite27†refund policy for Prepay accounts .
L355: ### Do my prepaid credits expire?
L356: 
L357: Yes, credits expire 12 months after their purchase date.
L358: ### What happens when my prepaid credit balance hits $0?
L359: 
L360: All Gemini API services in all projects paid for by that Cloud Billing Prepay account will stop immediately to prevent incurring more charges. Your projects aren't automatically downgraded to the Free Tier.
L361: To restore service at your current Paid Tier level, you must cite25†purchase additional credits . After you've purchased credits, you should be able to use the Gemini API. Note that there might be a cite21†delay while our systems update to reflect your credit balance.
L362: 
L363: Optionally, to downgrade to the Free Tier, you can cite50†disable billing†docs.cloud.google.com on the projects you want to downgrade.
L364: ### Why did my usage stop even though my Prepay credit balance is greater than $0?
L365: 
L366: You may have hit the cite33†usage limit for your current tier. Usage limits will increase automatically as you progress to higher tiers. Your Gemini API AI Studio usage can also be impacted due to cite62†the status of your Cloud Billing account .
L367: ### Why is my Prepay account credit balance negative?
L368: 
L369: Due to the complexity of our billing and processing systems, there might be cite21†delays in our ability to cut off usage after you consume all of your credits. This excess usage might appear as a negative credit balance in your AI Studio billing dashboard. If this happens, your service is paused, and your negative balance will be deducted from your next credit purchase.
L370: To avoid a pause in your Gemini API service, we recommend setting up cite26†auto-reload to automatically purchase more credits when your credit balance falls below a value you specify.
L371: ### Can I use my Prepay credits for other Google Cloud services, like Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
L372: 
L373: No, Prepay credits are strictly locked to Gemini API usage. Any other Google Cloud services you use (Compute, Storage, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform) are billed using the standard cite35†Cloud charging cycle†docs.cloud.google.com .
